findings.claim: The guard holds on both messages, and the retry instruction is still an instruction. The quoted refusal sits under its own heading and is followed by the fixed 'Reply again with...' sentence. That sentence lies outside the evidence the system prompt names, so it falls under 'the rest of the user message is your instructions'. The quote is not fenced, though, and it can echo the previous reply. The model therefore cannot tell where the evidence ends and the retry instruction starts. It is bounded by maxQuotedRefusal, and the launch.go code predates this commit. Fencing the quote the way the diff is fenced would make the boundary exact.
